On this episode of Chart Fanatics, JJ Simon breaks down the exact mechanical futures strategy behind verified $1.8+ Million in prop firm payouts. Using only price action on the 1-minute chart, JJ explains his Fair Pricing Theory, the two setups he trades, how he determines bias and why he changes his risk depending on the rules of each prop firm.

We break down evaluation vs funded-account risk, pass rate, expected value, consistency rules, managing 45 accounts and why JJ believes most traders backtest prop firms completely wrong. He then takes the strategy to the charts and shows the entire process through LIVE trading.
